answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. In practice this means a farm must spend real resources on every single alias, and that per-identity cost is what keeps the network honest at scale.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a jade as the anchor of the cost.
